name: Puffcap · Gremlet #33
description:
A mushroom spirit that puffs out a little cloud of golden spores when it laughs.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Puffcap in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
